name: pdf2md
description: Convert PDF attachments in ChatGPT Work into Markdown, with an optional local Python CLI.

author.name: THE DUCKS IN A ROW S.L.

interface.longDescription: Convert PDF files attached to a ChatGPT Work chat into downloadable Markdown files using Microsoft MarkItDown. Work processes attachments in OpenAI's cloud environment; PDF2MD does not send source PDFs to a publisher-operated conversion server or GitHub. For local, on-device conversion, the repository also provides a Python command-line tool.
interface.developerName: THE DUCKS IN A ROW S.L.
defaultPrompt: Convert the attached PDF to Markdown.
Convert all attached PDFs to Markdown.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission. Converts PDF attachments in ChatGPT Work to downloadable Markdown files.
